notes.title: Embracelet is out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37788559/dc72b1dbf34c50e1b4a7b97bdd872ef2f46b849d.jpg[/img]

[h1]It's adventure time![/h1]

I'm super excited to finally be able to launch my latest adventure game, Embracelet!

The game has been two years in the making, and it's such a joy to read the first reviews that are coming in. Nintendo World Report says "[i]...coming to the realization that I had just played one of the best narrative-driven games of my life.[/i]" and gave it a 9/10. Gamer.no gave it a 8/10 calling it "[i]a beautiful, funny and believable adventure.[/i]”. Daily Nintendo says "[i]Embracelet has made a big impression on me, which makes the game very beautiful and special.[/i]".

And now it's your turn to experience the island of Slepp and the stories of Jesper, Karoline and Hermod.

If you like story rich, gentle games this should be right up your alley. And if you enjoy it, please, please [b]leave a review[/b]. As a solo developer I don't have a huge marketing budget and people working to spread the word, so I [b]truly appreciate[/b] everyone who helps spread the word about Embracelet.

Enjoy!

Mattis

notes.title: Embracelet releases 24th of September!
notes.notes:
[h1]Good news everyone![/h1]

Embracelet, coming-of-age puzzle adventure from Machineboy is releasing on Steam this September 24th! If you are looking for a relaxing, heart-warming mystery adventure you won't have to wait long.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37788559/e647d8ca09ff73d7fe37b1b8f8308c0d2986fea4.png[/img]

[h2]Exploration, puzzles and an exciting story in a unique setting[/h2]
Embracelet puts you in the role of Jesper, a Norwegian teenager who lives with his mom in the city.

One day he is handed an old bracelet by his Grandfather who grew up in a fishing community up north. This bracelet has powers - strange, mysterious powers!

Jesper is given the task to unravel the mystery behind the bracelet. Where does it come from? Who does it belong to? And why did his Grandfather leave the island and his old life behind?

[h2]A magical bracelet[/h2]
The bracelet you inherited has some strange powers - it can move things from far away! Use the bracelet to solve puzzles and advance the story.

[h2]A cast of characters[/h2]
Meet people, make friends and make choices. Your behaviour and choices affect how other people feel about you - with different endings depending on how you play.

[h2]A beautiful soundtrack[/h2]
Let your shoulders drop as you slip into the low-poly Northern Norway scenery, pared with a beautiful and relaxing orchestral soundtrack with over 50 specifically composed tracks. The soundtrack is also [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383710/Embracelet_Soundtrack/]available on Steam[/url] (releasing the same date).

[h2]Made in Norway[/h2]
Embracelet is the works of one-man-band Machineboy (Mattis Folkestad) who previously released the award winning adventure [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/544970/Milkmaid_of_the_Milky_Way/]Milkmaid of the Milky Way[/url].

[h2]Wishlist[/h2]
If you think this could be a game for you, please wishlist it - and tell your adventurous friends about my upcoming game. Thanks!

Mattis Folkestad
Developer
